scope: Retrospective development diagnostics on a previously explored 2023-2024 period; not an untouched test or a live forecast
authorization: Continue saved three-track research; assistant research defaults, not user trading approval
input_features: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/日线特征与信号.sqlite
input_labels: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/开发期结果隔离.sqlite
event: C[t+5]/O[t+1]-1 > 0; zero price change joins nonpositive, counted separately

feature_groups.up: prior registered MA5>MA10>MA15 and MA15 rising signal equals 1
feature_groups.down: prior registered MA5<MA10<MA15 and MA15 falling signal equals 1
feature_groups.other: both prior MA structure signals are 0
feature_groups.missing: either prior MA structure signal is NULL; abstain

empty_training_group_policy: explicit prior-only shrinkage result pg=p0; log group_n=0
training_policy: Expanding development history; both signal_date and actual label end must be strictly before validation_start; feature-valid rows only. Freeze fitted values for each entire validation fold.
validation_policy: Both models share exactly the same feature-valid and label-mature dates. Actual label end must be <= validation_end. Missing features or insufficient training produce explicit abstention, never zero fill or silent model replacement.
prior_ex_rights_and_boundary_exclusions: Retain the prior registered outcome table's known ex-date exclusions and global development-end exclusions
fixed_grid_sensitivity: Single offset: every fifth original development anchor starting at 2023-01-03, shared with previous batch; no best offset selection
candidate_later_evaluation_period: 2026, not opened in this run and not certified historically untouched
